## About

Innovate and Amplify is a founder-led AI automation and web development studio
founded in 2024 by Austin Harrison. The studio helps small businesses and creators
build high-performing websites, AI-powered workflows, and modern digital systems.
It operates as a direct-collaboration model — no account managers, no agency layers.

## Founder

Austin Harrison — Founder and Developer
Phone: +1 (425) 582-1003
Email: contact@innovateandamplify.com
Website: https://innovateandamplify.com

## Services

- Web Development: Custom web applications built with React, Next.js, and Node.js.
  Responsive design, e-commerce solutions, and scalable architecture.
- AI Automation: Workflow automation, AI agents and assistants, API integrations,
  and internal tooling built for business-specific workflows.
- Digital Marketing: SEO optimisation, social media strategy, analytics, and
  conversion-focused campaign management.

## Key Facts

- Founded: 2024
- Studio type: Solo / founder-led
- Location: Spokane, WA
- Client websites live: 2 (Evergreen Rain Gutters, MICRIST Environmental)
- Products in beta: 1 (Starlit Stories)
- Every project is built by the founder, Austin Harrison
- Published results: none yet; the two client sites are live and linked below
- Primary clients: Local service businesses
- Business hours: Mon–Fri 9 AM–6 PM, Sat 10 AM–4 PM (US Pacific)

## Selected Work

- Evergreen Rain Gutters (client, Spokane) — website with an on-site AI assistant and instant lead alerts to the owner: https://evergreenrainguttersllc.com
- MICRIST Environmental (client, Washington) — website with a course catalog, online payments, and a client-edited CMS: https://micristenviro.com
- SP-Archives (photographer Skyelar Payne, Pacific Northwest and North Idaho) — photography archive website with session inquiries: https://sp-archives.com
- Starlit Stories (own product, in beta) — personalized children's storybook generator (React, Azure, OpenAI)
